answer_1.quote: We evaluate MBR-OT on multiple directed text generation tasks: document-level machine translation, document-level text simplification, and dense image captioning.
answer_1.outputs: generated documents, simplified texts, and image captions

answer_2.quote: We evaluate BLEU score using sacrebleu library, BERTScore (bert-base-multilingual-cased), a cosine distance of the sentence embedding model (SentBERT), MetricX-23, COMET-22, SFR-2, ROUGE, D‑SARI, and CLAIR.

answer_3.quote: CLAIR uses GPT-4 as a judge to compute the utility of the caption. ... we use MetricX-23 as the utility function for MBR decoding.
